bio.text: Malissa is a Clinical Nutritionist, MasterChef Australia Finalist, recipe developer and media personality known as The Mood Boosting Nutritionist™. With a background in Italian cooking and evidence-based nutrition, she blends culinary skill with emotional wellbeing, specialising in the Food x Mood connection. Malissa has been featured on The Morning Show, Sunrise, across major publications and podcast platforms, and leads sought-after cooking classes, pasta-making masterclasses, corporate workshops and wellness events. Her work blends nutrition science with joyful, mood-boosting cooking.
